scope: Fixed synthetic out-of-basis validation, small paired sample, no real RF confirmation or population coverage claim.

plan.policy: No retries, case replacement, estimator edits or threshold tuning. Retain all paired outcomes. Eight noise pairs do not establish population coverage.
plan.heldout: receiver 7 at 30 and 60 s, no systematic disturbance; independent clock/ground/measurement Gaussian block

forecast.scope: Unconditional local Gaussian prediction-error covariance before held-out target reveal. No conditional holdout correction or total nonlinear/systematic bound.
